entities.summary: Yoann Jaumel  is a French volleyball player. He was part of the France men's national volleyball team at the 2014 FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship in Poland, and 2015 FIVB Volleyball World League in Rio de Janeiro. He is currently playing for Nice Volleyball.
